title: Stamp provenance on every state progression
description: Record which ingress caused each domain mutation. Second repair of LB-21-PLAN-F1: the previous repair named ten writers but claimed eight tables and stamped only the eight direct INSERTs, leaving the two db.ts profile setters and the two behaviour-status UPDATEs unstamped, and never defined triggered_by or trigger_data values. This contract maps every writer to all of its write targets and readouts and fixes the column semantics.

behaviors.title: All twelve write sites across the ten written tables stamp provenance
behaviors.trigger: Any of the ten mutation writers runs: recordShape (shape_assessments via db.setShapeProfile), recordPlanning (planning_profiles via db.setPlanningProfile), importContract (issues, behaviors, planning_profiles), upsertPlanningFinding (planning_findings), recordPlanningReviewPass (planning_review_passes), recordPass (review_passes), upsertFinding (findings), recordEvidence (evidence), verifyBehavior (behaviors status UPDATE), createWaiver (waivers plus behaviors status UPDATE)
behaviors.expected: Every resulting row version carries a non-null trigger_type and triggered_by, including the two profile setters written through db.ts and both behaviour-status UPDATE paths, not only the eight direct INSERT sites
behaviors.verify: Drive all ten writers through real CLI and MCP ingresses against a disposable database and read back every one of the ten tables, asserting non-null trigger_type and triggered_by on each written row version, with the two profile-setter rows and both behaviour-status progressions asserted explicitly

behaviors.title: trigger_type is the ingress that opened the database
behaviors.trigger: A mutation runs through an ingress that called openDb
behaviors.expected: trigger_type is exactly one of cli, mcp, hook, or plugin_hook, determined by the ingress: mcp.ts openDb yields mcp, cli.ts main openDb yields cli, the CLI hook command openDb yields hook, and plugin-hook.ts openDb yields plugin_hook; hook and plugin_hook are reachable values but write no rows in this slice because hooks are read-only
behaviors.verify: Perform the identical mutation once through the CLI and once through the MCP server against a disposable database and observe exactly cli and mcp on the two persisted rows, and assert by source scan that no hook path invokes a writer

behaviors.title: triggered_by and trigger_data have defined values
behaviors.trigger: Provenance is stamped at any write site
behaviors.expected: triggered_by is never null: for the cli ingress it is LOOPBREAKER_ACTOR when set, otherwise the operating-system username, otherwise the literal unknown; for the mcp ingress it is the MCP client name reported at initialize when available, otherwise the literal mcp-client. trigger_data is a nullable JSON object: for the cli ingress it is the parsed subcommand name, which is known before openDb is called; for the mcp, hook, and plugin_hook ingresses it is null in this slice
behaviors.verify: Against a disposable database, write once through the CLI with LOOPBREAKER_ACTOR set and once unset, and once through MCP, asserting the exact triggered_by value in each case and the expected trigger_data subcommand object for the CLI writes and null for the MCP write

behaviors.title: No mutation path bypasses provenance
behaviors.trigger: The demo action updates a finding status via the raw UPDATE at server.ts:72, which today bypasses src/domain.ts entirely
behaviors.expected: That path is routed through upsertFinding so it carries provenance, and no raw INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE of a domain row remains outside src/domain.ts and the db.ts setters
behaviors.verify: Invoke the DEMO-1 finding action through the real HTTP surface against a disposable database, assert the resulting row carries provenance, and assert by source scan that no raw domain-row write remains outside the sanctioned paths

behaviors.title: Provenance surfaces in the substrate readout for every record type that carries it
behaviors.trigger: substrate() renders the issue, its behaviors, planning and shape profiles, planning findings, planning-review passes, review passes, findings, evidence, and waivers
behaviors.expected: Each rendered record type exposes its trigger_type, triggered_by, and trigger_data, including the behaviour-status progressions recorded by verifyBehavior and createWaiver
behaviors.verify: Read a live substrate response over the real CLI and MCP surfaces against a disposable database seeded through all ten writers, and assert the provenance triple is present on every record type that carries it

behaviors.title: The visualizer shows provenance on a record
behaviors.trigger: The visualizer renders a pass, evidence, or finding node
behaviors.expected: The node footer shows the provenance of that record
behaviors.verify: Render the node in web/src/graph.ts and observe the provenance footer line

planning.outcome: Every row version written on the mutation path is attributable to the ingress that caused it, with defined column values and no bypassing write path.
planning.appetite: One instance-carried provenance slice: two signature changes, four ingress edits, and twelve stamped write sites.
non_goals: Per-MCP-tool granularity: mcp.ts:90 opens one shared db handle closed over by every handler, and handlers are async and may interleave, so mutable per-call ambient provenance on that shared instance would be unsafe
Distinctly labelling seed.ts writes, which inherit the CLI handle
A full append-only events log spanning session and workflow planes (stays in Rordi)
Provenance on the idempotent migrate() DDL, which writes no rows

work_units.title: Carry the provenance triple on the LoopbreakerDb instance and define its values
work_units.done_when: openDb and the constructor accept the triple, the four ingresses set it, and trigger_type, triggered_by, and trigger_data resolve to the defined values at each ingress

work_units.title: Stamp all twelve write sites across the ten written tables
work_units.done_when: The eight direct INSERTs, both db.ts profile setters, and both behaviour-status UPDATE paths persist the triple

work_units.title: Route the server.ts demo raw write through upsertFinding
work_units.done_when: server.ts performs no raw domain-row write and the demo finding update carries provenance

work_units.title: Expose the triple in substrate() and the visualizer
work_units.done_when: Every record type that carries provenance exposes it in the read model, and node footers render it

proofs.method: Drive all ten writers through real CLI/MCP ingresses and assert the triple on every row version in all ten tables, explicitly including the two profile-setter rows and both behaviour-status progressions.
Identical mutation through CLI and MCP asserting exactly cli and mcp, plus a source scan proving no hook path invokes a writer.
CLI writes with LOOPBREAKER_ACTOR set and unset plus one MCP write, asserting exact triggered_by values and the expected trigger_data object or null.
Invoke the DEMO-1 finding action over HTTP, assert provenance on the row, and source-scan for any remaining raw domain-row write.
Seed a disposable database through all ten writers and assert the triple on every record type in a live substrate response over CLI and MCP.
Render a node and observe the provenance footer.

planning.production_wiring: Add trigger_type, triggered_by, and trigger_data columns via additive ALTER TABLE in migrate() (db.ts, following the precedent at db.ts:153-158) to all ten written tables: shape_assessments, planning_profiles, issues, behaviors, planning_findings, planning_review_passes, review_passes, findings, evidence, waivers. Add a readonly provenance field to the LoopbreakerDb constructor (db.ts:23) and a provenance parameter to openDb (db.ts:253). Set it at the four ingresses: mcp.ts:90 (mcp), cli.ts:322 (cli, with the parsed subcommand as trigger_data), cli.ts:294 (hook), plugin-hook.ts:60 (plugin_hook). Stamp all twelve write sites: the eight direct INSERTs in domain.ts (371 issues, 378 behaviors, 435 planning_findings, 474 planning_review_passes, 514 review_passes, 561 findings, 600 evidence, 638 waivers); the two db.ts setters setPlanningProfile (db.ts:215-218) and setShapeProfile (db.ts:227-230), which must accept and persist the triple; and the two behaviour-status UPDATE paths, verifyBehavior (domain.ts:626) and the behaviors UPDATE inside createWaiver (domain.ts:643), which must set the triple alongside status. Route server.ts:72's raw UPDATE through upsertFinding. Expose the triple per record type in substrate() and render it in web/src/graph.ts.
planning.rollback: The columns are additive and nullable. Stop setting provenance at the four ingresses and drop the readout; existing rows and every gate behave exactly as before, with no data loss and no schema reversal required.
planning.migration: Additive nullable columns only. Existing rows are left null and read as the literal legacy source in the read model; no backfill is attempted because the causing ingress is unknowable retroactively. Re-running the migration changes nothing.

risks.risk: Instance-level provenance cannot distinguish which MCP tool caused a write.
risks.mitigation: Ingress granularity is the explicit scope; per-tool granularity is a named non-goal because the shared interleaving handler makes ambient per-call state unsafe.

risks.risk: A write site outside the eight direct INSERTs could be missed, leaving a silent gap.
risks.mitigation: All twelve sites are enumerated in production_wiring and asserted table-by-table by the LB-21-B1 proof, with the profile setters and behaviour-status progressions called out explicitly.

risks.risk: Routing server.ts:72 through upsertFinding changes demo behavior.
risks.mitigation: The demo path is DEMO-1 gated and covered by the LB-21-B4 wired proof over the real HTTP surface.
